changelog: - **A mentorship relation's company is an ADMIN decision, and only within the admin's own tenant** (#2613, from the #2580 review). `PUT /api/mentorship/[id]` took `companyId` as a free string: the relation's owner could re-point it at any company of the tenant (a MARKETING rep's `/sales/accounts/[id]` then rendered that account's description, address, contact e-mail and needs), and — with `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` off — an ADMIN could attach another tenant's company and read its name back from the response's `include`, while an unknown id surfaced as a foreign-key 500. #2593 had closed the owner half only where the `mentorship` capability is absent. Now a non-admin changing the company gets **403 `company_change_admin_only`** in every vertical (checked before any lookup; echoing the current value stays a no-op — no non-admin screen sends it), and the target is resolved inside the caller's tenant by the new `refuseForeignCompany()` (`src/lib/relationCompany.ts`, `tenantWhere`/`withinTenant`): another tenant's company and a nonexistent id answer the same **404 `company_not_found`** body. `POST /api/mentorship`, which had no check at all, uses the same helper. The relation lookup of `GET`/`PUT /api/mentorship/[id]` is itself tenant-scoped now, so another tenant's ADMIN gets 404 instead of reading or editing it by id. Other writers were checked: the MARKETING account import creates the company it attaches, and the mentor transfer copies the relation's own. New `e2e/relation-company-guard.spec.ts`; the MARKETING sales matrix gains the re-point and cross-org PUT probes.
